messages:
nuria: Quick heads-up: CI flagged an example lint failure in /sdk/examples/python - the README's snippet uses `from redwood import client_v1` which is stale and causes the sample tests to fail. Anyone owns that page?

ben: I touched that one a while back. The correct import is `from redwood import RedwoodClient` now. Should be a 1-line fix.

nuria: thanks. I'll draft a tiny PR but also want to avoid the copy/paste issue where people paste the old import into demos. Maybe add a tiny note 'Updated for SDK v2' and a test to catch regressions.

kai: agree on the test. Can we add a unit that runs the snippet with Python -c? e.g. `python -c "from redwood import RedwoodClient; print('ok')"` in the docs CI job. low effort and useful.

ben: sounds good. i'll review the PR. @triage-bot can you label it docs/quick and assign to ben for CR?

triage-bot: label applied: docs/quick. assignee: ben.

nuria: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4420 title: "docs(sdk): update python example import + test" description includes small pytest that executes the example snippet.

ben: reviewing now. quick note: also replace a second occurrence in /examples/tutorial.md where the old import remains. I'll include that in my review comment.

nuria: thanks. If ben approves i'll merge once CI snippet test passes.

docs-bot: PR merged by ben 1: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4420 deployed to staging.

kai: verified staging preview and sample-run CI. snippet test caught a second stale import in tutorial and we fixed it. closing loop. :white_check_mark:
